comments:
In the teaching lineage of Zang rings grags pa dar ma tshul khrims (ID:4011) ([8GL7ZT7Y]: 25, translated from [8GL7ZT7Y]: 15a3).
See [CTAI38G9]: 924 on his nicknames "tshad ma'i skyes bu" and "rigs thigs pa," and his dates, proposed to be ca. 1235-1315, considering that he was teaching at Khro phu in 1307 and taught until his 83rd year.

[CTAI38G9]: 928 defends the idea that "Tshad ma'i skyes bu" is bSod nams mgon po and not Don grub dpal, another teacher of Bu ston (ID:5999).
